name: Melody of Sheltered Rest

automation.text: You sing or hum an upbeat melody. For the duration, an aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation. A creature within the aura (including you) can extend the duration for another 2 hours, as long as it continues singing. This can repeat for as long as a creature within the aura continues singing. While in the aura, creatures have Advantage on Perception checks and cannot be Surprised.
